dani-engineer: quick heads-up, found CI artifact uploads referencing Vault wrap token ids in partner-bucket (partner-snapshots/sep/). looks like a job archived wrapped blobs instead of redacting.
marie-sec: yikes. which job? was this the refactor to artifact-uploader v2?
dani-engineer: yes, job: ci/artifacts/upload-v2 #4578. runner used SA sa-ci-uploader@redwood.internal. upload time 2024-09-18T06:22Z. Object metadata has keys: vault-wrap-id=wrap-20240918-09 and transit-key=wrap-v2.
sam-devops: immediate steps: 1) revoke any active wrapping keys 2) freeze partner bucket restores for that window 3) pull objects into analyst project for safe inspection.
tasha-sre: oncall here. I'll add bucket freeze and create a temp ACL denying restores from partner side. Sam, can you revoke SA keys if they were used?
sam-devops: running commands now:
```
# freeze bucket (remove requester pays / set temp deny)
# gcloud storage objects update --bucket partner-bucket --object=partner-snapshots/sep/* --no-restore
# revoke SA key example
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID --iam-account=sa-ci-uploader@redwood.internal
```
marie-sec: also check Vault audit for unwrap/unwrap-allowed ops and any sys/wrapping/wrap calls. we need to know if private material was wrapped or just tokens.
dani-engineer: I grep'd the artifacts locally; one tar contains `id_rsa_deploy` under `secrets/` and a small metadata file indicating it was wrapped via transit key wrap-v2.
amsam-devops: that's escalation. schedule KMS rotation and start rewrap plan. we need to plan for legitimate consumers too.
tasha-sre: starting incident process and paging infra-sre. I'll take revocation + partner communication.
marie-sec: create a minimal blast-radius checklist: rotate KMS key (provision new key), rewrap legit ciphertexts, revoke SA keys, rotate any deploy keys found in repos, add pre-merge hook to prevent archiving files with vault-wrap-id metadata.
dani-engineer: I'll open PR with lint rule and update uploader to strip vault metadata by default.
engsec-bot: Recorded: possible-secret-export, tag: secrets-exposure, ticket: TICK-2024-3321
